channel.title: World
channel.description: The Washington Post World section provides information and analysis of breaking world news stories. In addition to our world news and video, Post World News offers discussions and blogs on major international news and economic issues.

item.title: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle will return to Britain after six years in U.S.
item.dc:creator: Steve Hendrix
item.description: The prince and his wife have been estranged from the royal family but are now returning to England with their children, Prince Archie, 7, and Princess Lilibet, 5.

item.title: UAE says it is suspending trade with Iran after missile launch
item.dc:creator: Ellen Francis, Rachel Chason
item.description: The UAE, one of Iran’s biggest trading partners, said the move was “in light of regional escalations that undermine regional and international peace and security.”

item.title: Defense minister dismissed by Zelensky demands elections in Ukraine
item.dc:creator: David Stern, Anastacia Galouchka
item.description: The move from an architect of Ukraine’s drone program is a remarkably direct challenge to President Volodymyr Zelensky’s authority and may test Ukrainian unity.
